Routing​

Routes are declared in routes.ts. See the router API for the full surface.

Every route needs a path and a handler. Paths are matched in declaration order, so put specific routes before catch-alls or the catch-all will swallow them.

Defining a route​

router.get("/users/:id", getUser);
